author: Zhi-Hong Sun
title: Generalized Legendre polynomials and related congruences modulo p^2
used_for: Exact finite recurrence, specialized top-coefficient quotient, reflection modulo p². The exact contiguous eliminations and lower-degree norm/jet equivalence are derived in this return.
bounded_search_note: A few targeted follow-up primary-literature searches did not produce a matched all-prime norm/jet normalization theorem. No claim of exhaustive prior-art search or novelty follows.
